faq.q: How much does Addabbo & Greenberg Law charge?
faq.a: Addabbo & Greenberg Law publishes no fee terms on the pages we read, so none is recorded on this profile. An absence here is not a claim that the firm has no fee arrangement, only that it does not state one publicly. The rate itself is not published, so ask for it in writing, along with how case expenses are handled and whether they come out of the recovery before or after the fee. The first consultation is free, which is the place to ask.

faq.q: Does Addabbo & Greenberg Law offer a free consultation?
faq.a: Yes. Addabbo & Greenberg Law publishes a free initial consultation.

faq.q: Where does Addabbo & Greenberg Law have offices?
faq.a: Addabbo & Greenberg Law publishes one office, in Forest Hills. Addresses and the Google listing behind each one are on this profile under Offices.

faq.q: Who are the attorneys at Addabbo & Greenberg Law?
faq.a: Addabbo & Greenberg Law names twelve attorneys on its own site, and each is listed on this profile with the page we read them from.

faq.q: Are the case results Addabbo & Greenberg Law publishes verified?
faq.a: No. Addabbo & Greenberg Law publishes eight case results with amounts on its own site. We counted them and we did not confirm them: the figures are the firm's. Pillar B scores whether a firm publishes outcomes and discloses them properly, including whether a prior-results disclaimer appears beside them, not whether the amounts are right. Past results do not predict another case.

faq.q: What has Law Firm Listings verified about Addabbo & Greenberg Law?
faq.a: Addabbo & Greenberg Law scores 54 and sits at Verified. Passed: website and footprint. Did not pass: licensure, discipline and entity registration.
